name: Semgrep
summary: Application security platform for code scanning (SAST), dependencies (SCA) and secrets, with AI triage.
description: Semgrep scans source code for security issues with its SAST engine, checks open-source dependencies for vulnerabilities and malware, and detects hardcoded secrets. AI features help triage and fix findings. The scanning engine is open source. A free edition with cross-file analysis is available for small teams, and paid plans are priced per contributor per month. The company runs a programme for teams moving from Checkmarx or Snyk.

howToUse.title: Add the scanner
howToUse.description: Sign in at Semgrep and connect the repository, or run the open-source engine on the code yourself.

howToUse.title: Scan the source
howToUse.description: Run the SAST scan so Semgrep reports security issues in the source code.

howToUse.title: Check dependencies and secrets
howToUse.description: Turn on the supply-chain checks for vulnerable or malicious dependencies, and the scan for hardcoded secrets.

howToUse.title: Triage the findings
howToUse.description: Use the AI triage, fix the findings that matter, and use the free edition with cross-file analysis if the team is small.
